fee_notes: Royalty is tiered from 3% to 10% of monthly Gross Volume with a 10% cap; tiers range from 10% (at $0-$13,196.99/mo) down to 5% (over $219,947/mo). A Fixed Fee of $45-$115 per month is charged based on Gross Volume tier. Reduced Rate Services (reconstruction, construction, property repairs) have a separate royalty schedule starting at 4.5%-5%. Brand Fund Fee is currently 2.5% of monthly Gross Volume (cap $1,550,000) plus 0.25% on Reduced Rate Services, up to a maximum of 3%. Minimum royalty fee of $100/month. New franchisees pay 10% royalty flat until completion of FDIP training program. Software License and Technology fee is $200/month per franchise license beginning the 1st day of the third month after signing.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty fee (Notes 1, 2, 3 and 4): Currently ranges from 3% to 10% of Your monthly Gross Volume with a 10% cap | Monthly, on a date We designate | You must pay Us a percentage of the Gross Volume of Your Franchise.

Fixed fee (Notes 1 and 4): $45-$115 based on Your monthly Gross Volume | Same date as Royalty Fee | You must pay Us a Fixed Fee based on Your monthly Gross Volume.

Minimum royalty fee: $100 | Monthly, on a date We designate | You must pay Us a Minimum royalty fee based on Your monthly Gross Volume.

Brand Fund Fee (Note 1 and Item 11): 3% of Your monthly Gross Volume | Same date as Royalty Fee | We may collect up to 3% of Your monthly Gross Volume as a Brand Fund Fee. Currently, we collect 2 ½ % of Your monthly Gross Volume (not including Gross Volume from Reduced Rate Services) subject to a 'cap' of $1,550,000. In the past, We excluded Reduced Rate Services from Brand Fund contributions. However, We are collecting ¼% of Gross Volume on Reduced Rate Services.

Software License and Technology Agreement (Note 1): $200 per month per franchise license, regardless of common ownership, beginning the 1st day of the third month after You sign the Franchise License Agreement, subject to change due to increased costs and/or CPI-U adjustments. | Net 30 after billing | Included in Servpro Equipment and Products Package for franchisees entering NFTP. Included is Our proprietary lead entry, estimating, reporting and job file and office management software, WorkCenter™.
